decision: Recast from 'ledger reconciliation + closeout cards' to the ActionItem RESOLVABILITY CONTRACT per operator direction. Root cause is structural: DontPanic emits operator actions without proving they are still relevant, sufficient, recomputed after action, or cleared when the condition is gone (live: 54/57 gate cards target completed/abandoned plans; reconcile card couldn't round-trip). Spine = clears_when + resolution_class (F001), round-trip recompute/suppress-at-source + global-scope eval (F002), phantom suppression proof (F003), reconcile/global readiness round-trip + chaining + operator_attested (F004), generic round-trip invariant test over every emitter (F005). Individual bad cards become regression cases, not the unit of work.

Contract decisions locked (operator review before code): (1) clears_when = CLOSED PREDICATE REGISTRY of named pure checks with bound params (no expression DSL) — F005's invariant test iterates the registry. (2) Resolution = SUPPRESS-AT-SOURCE + audit trail: never emit an item whose clears_when is satisfied; log why suppressed. (3) resolution_class keeps FOUR values: command_resolvable | chained | operator_attested | blocked_external (operator_attested = you can act+attest; blocked_external = waiting on external, nothing to do now). (4) Gate/approve cards emit only for the LIVE-BUT-UNFINISHED status set {active, ready_for_audit, in_audit, blocked}; excluded: draft (pre-lock), completed, abandoned.

F003 enum-vs-string leak (discovered building the integration test): plan_loader returns Status/HumanGate ENUM values, but clears_when predicates compare against the string status set (LIVE_BUT_UNFINISHED) and string gate names. Leaking Status.active into live_state made `Status.active not in {"active",...}` True, wrongly suppressing live plans' gate cards. Fixed at the producer boundary in dashboard._gather_action_items (coerce status.value + gate.value to strings) rather than in the predicate, so live_state stays plain-string per the F002 LiveState design. Live ledger measured: 65 gate cards -> 1 (64 suppressed: 47 completed + 11 abandoned + 6 draft).

Pre-existing time-nondeterminism flake in test_renderer_parity_f003::test_dashboard_build_writes_what_now_through_the_render_boundary exposed (not caused) by F003's new test file shifting collection order. Line 265 compared the build-written what-now.json (captured_at stamped from live now) against a FRESH render_cli_what_now(items, fmt='json') with no captured_at — byte-identical only when both calls land in the same wall-clock second. Hardened: parse the written file's own captured_at and pass it to the comparison render, so the assertion tests render-boundary parity deterministically. Classified test-hardening (not a feature defect); the F003 production change does not run inside this test (it monkeypatches _gather_action_items).

F004 resolution-class assignments: reconcile missing_snapshot=chained (baseline is step 1; the stale-cache card is the surfaced next step) + stale_status_cache=command_resolvable, both clears_when=install_snapshot_fresh (snapshot present AND cache fresh). Drift kinds (new/removed/changed) keep command_resolvable + clears_when=None — they clear by RECONSTRUCTION (next clean reconcile check omits them), not by recompute-suppression. Capability needs_setup/blocked reclassified command_resolvable->operator_attested with clears_when=capability_ready: their existing exact_command `dontpanic capabilities status <id>` is a READ-ONLY diagnostic that never resolved them (a concrete instance of the non-resolving-guidance bug), so they must clear on re-probe EVIDENCE, not on the command. Live-state for both predicates derived at fleet scope in dashboard._reconcile_live_state / _capabilities_live_state from the reconcile result + capability envelope already passed to _gather_action_items.

F005 invariant recognises a THIRD resolution mechanism the plan text did not name: RECONSTRUCTION-resolvable. The plan acceptance said the only non-clears_when escape is operator_attested/blocked_external, but operations-guidance NEEDS_ACTION items (operator decision prompts: wait/redispatch, raise-ceiling, finalize, resume/close) predate this plan and are projected FRESH from live ActionChoices every build — a resolved decision is simply not re-emitted, so they need no clears_when. The invariant allows command_resolvable+clears_when=None ONLY for reconstruction-projected sources (source=supervisor, id-prefix 'operations:'), NEVER for a static emitter (the original gate bug was a static emitter masquerading as resolvable — F003 made gates reconstruction-AND-recompute resolvable). Negative guard test proves a static NEEDS_ACTION+command_resolvable+clears_when=None card FAILS the invariant. Spec-clarification, operator-accept in spec rather than burning an audit.
